item-handbooktext-static-saber:
A good choice for efficiently slicing up opponents. The blade can be heated red-hot to ignite enemies.
When discharged, it will stop dealing damage. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-static-spear:
A good choice for making holes in opponents. Has two modes when thrown: standard and ionizing spear. In the second mode, the spear causes strong air ionization upon hitting any living creature. This provokes a lightning strike and also ignites the creature. Consumes 10% of its charge capacity in this mode.
Playing with lightning is dangerous - be careful.
When discharged, it will stop dealing damage. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-static-shield:
Excellent protection with a built-in flashlight.
When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-static-helmet:
Excellent protection and capabilities.
When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-static-armor:
Excellent protection and capabilities. Allows flight by pressing the R key.
When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage and the flight mode will deactivate. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-static-boots:
Excellent protection and capabilities.
When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-edrill:
Mining reaches a new level. Operates in several modes: 1x1, 1x3 (vertically), 3x1 (horizontally), 3x3. In 3x3 mode, consumption is tripled.
When discharged, it will stop working. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-echisel:
Performs the functions of a battery-powered chisel! No need for a hammer in the left hand. Not used in recipes.
When discharged, it will stop working. Don't forget to charge it!
item-handbooktext-edrilltip: The base component for the Electric Drill.
item-handbooktext-eaxe:
Excellent at chopping. Not used in recipes.
When discharged, it will stop working. Don't forget to charge it!
